async def act(page):
    """
    Navigate to the Sales > Orders grid and filter the grid to Status = "Complete".

    Steps:
    - Use a relative goto to the sales orders index so the action is idempotent.
    - Locate the Status combobox by accessible name; if absent, scan comboboxes
      for one containing an option named "Complete".
    - Select the "Complete" option (prefer label selection, fall back to option
      value if needed).
    - Click the Search button to apply the filter. When possible, click the
      Search button found within the same group as the Status combobox to
      avoid ambiguity; otherwise fall back to a global Search button.
    """
    # Navigate to the Sales > Orders grid (relative URL)
    await page.goto('/index.php/admin/sales_order/index/')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')

    # Try to find a combobox with accessible name 'Status'
    status_cb = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Status")
    if await status_cb.count() == 0:
        # Fallback: scan all comboboxes and pick the one that contains an option named 'Complete'
        comboboxes = page.get_by_role("combobox")
        found_cb = None
        combobox_count = await comboboxes.count()
        for i in range(combobox_count):
            cb = comboboxes.nth(i)
            # Look for an option with visible name 'Complete' inside this combobox
            if await cb.get_by_role("option", name="Complete").count() > 0:
                found_cb = cb
                break
        if found_cb is not None:
            status_cb = found_cb

    # If we found a combobox, attempt to select the 'Complete' option
    if await status_cb.count() > 0:
        # Prefer selecting by visible label first
        try:
            await status_cb.select_option(label="Complete")
        except Exception:
            # Narrow fallback: scan options for a case-insensitive match and select by value
            options = status_cb.get_by_role("option")
            chosen_value = None
            opt_count = await options.count()
            for j in range(opt_count):
                opt = options.nth(j)
                try:
                    txt = (await opt.inner_text()).strip()
                except Exception:
                    txt = ""
                if 'complete' in txt.lower():
                    chosen_value = await opt.get_attribute('value')
                    break
            if chosen_value:
                await status_cb.select_option(value=chosen_value)

    # Click the Search button to apply the filter. Prefer the Search button
    # that is in the same group as the status combobox (to use a full path).
    search_btn = None
    if await status_cb.count() > 0:
        # Attempt to find a group that contains the status combobox
        groups_with_cb = page.get_by_role("group").filter(has=status_cb)
        if await groups_with_cb.count() > 0:
            # Prefer a button inside that group
            candidate = groups_with_cb.first.get_by_role("button", name="Search")
            if await candidate.count() > 0:
                search_btn = candidate
    # Fallback to any global Search button
    if search_btn is None:
        candidate_global = page.get_by_role("button", name="Search")
        if await candidate_global.count() > 0:
            search_btn = candidate_global

    if search_btn is not None and await search_btn.count() > 0:
        await search_btn.first.click()

    # Allow a short moment for the grid to refresh
    import asyncio
    await asyncio.sleep(1)

async def act(page):
    """
    Navigate to the Sales > Orders grid and filter the grid to Status = "Complete".

    Steps:
    - Use a relative goto to the sales orders index so the action is idempotent.
    - Locate the Status combobox by accessible name; if absent, scan comboboxes
      for one containing an option named "Complete".
    - Select the "Complete" option (prefer label selection, fall back to option
      value if needed).
    - Click the Search button to apply the filter. When possible, click the
      Search button found within the same group as the Status combobox to
      avoid ambiguity; otherwise fall back to a global Search button.
    """
    # Navigate to the Sales > Orders grid (relative URL)
    await page.goto('/index.php/admin/sales_order/index/')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')

    # Try to find a combobox with accessible name 'Status'
    status_cb = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Status")
    if await status_cb.count() == 0:
        # Fallback: scan all comboboxes and pick the one that contains an option named 'Complete'
        comboboxes = page.get_by_role("combobox")
        found_cb = None
        combobox_count = await comboboxes.count()
        for i in range(combobox_count):
            cb = comboboxes.nth(i)
            # Look for an option with visible name 'Complete' inside this combobox
            if await cb.get_by_role("option", name="Complete").count() > 0:
                found_cb = cb
                break
        if found_cb is not None:
            status_cb = found_cb

    # If we found a combobox, attempt to select the 'Complete' option
    if await status_cb.count() > 0:
        # Prefer selecting by visible label first
        try:
            await status_cb.select_option(label="Complete")
        except Exception:
            # Narrow fallback: scan options for a case-insensitive match and select by value
            options = status_cb.get_by_role("option")
            chosen_value = None
            opt_count = await options.count()
            for j in range(opt_count):
                opt = options.nth(j)
                try:
                    txt = (await opt.inner_text()).strip()
                except Exception:
                    txt = ""
                if 'complete' in txt.lower():
                    chosen_value = await opt.get_attribute('value')
                    break
            if chosen_value:
                await status_cb.select_option(value=chosen_value)

    # Click the Search button to apply the filter. Prefer the Search button
    # that is in the same group as the status combobox (to use a full path).
    search_btn = None
    if await status_cb.count() > 0:
        # Attempt to find a group that contains the status combobox
        groups_with_cb = page.get_by_role("group").filter(has=status_cb)
        if await groups_with_cb.count() > 0:
            # Prefer a button inside that group

    if search_btn is None:

        if await candidate_global.count() > 0:
            search_btn = candidate_global

    if search_btn is not None and await search_btn.count() > 0:
        await search_btn.first.click()

    # Allow a short moment for the grid to refresh
    import asyncio
    await asyncio.sleep(1)
